description: POST /v0/pipes/<name>.<format> "Returns the published node data in a particular format, passing the parameters in the request body" (https://www.tinybird.co/docs/api-reference/pipe-api). The parameters are the Pipe's own caller-named template parameters, so the request is an open object and they travel as JSON body keys. Live: queryPipeWithBody({ pipe: "distilled_endpoint", format: "json", city: "Madrid" }) answered data [{city: "Madrid", total: 5}].
